newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore private property price index falls 2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Singapore private property price index falls 2 pct.

text.p: Singapore's price index for private residential properties fell by 2.0 percent during third quarter 1996, compared to a 6.0 percent rise in the second quarter, the Urban Redevelopment Authority (URA) said on Friday.
Prices of landed properties fell 2.1 percent during the third quarter after a 1.8 percent rise in the second. Detached houses fell 1.8 percent after a 1.9 percent second quarter decline.
The property price index of commercial properties rose 0.6 percent during the third quarter, compared to a 1.1 percent rise in the second quarter, the URA said.
It said prices of office space increased 0.3 percent, compared to 0.8 percent in the previous quarter. Prices of industrial properties rose 2.4 percent, compared to a 1.1 percent second quarter rise.
